question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

It was __evident__ from his gestures that he was feeling guilty.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Hidden.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given question, let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word 'evident' means clearly visible or noticeable.**
